unit_cn: Unit 5 What an Adventure! 冒险经历
source: 外研社(新标准)必修第三册 Unit 5 词表(p117-118 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、冒险/探险主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Our initial plan was to climb the mountain in just three days.
words.example_cn: 我们最初的计划是只用三天就登上这座山。

words.example_en: The air was very thin, and thus many climbers felt weak.
words.example_cn: 空气十分稀薄,因此许多登山者感到虚弱。

words.example_en: Above 8,000 metres lies the death zone, where the body cannot last long.
words.example_cn: 8000米以上是死亡地带,人体在那里无法久留。

words.example_en: Near the summit there is far less oxygen than at sea level.
words.example_cn: 在接近峰顶处,氧气比海平面少得多。

words.example_en: Qomolangma lies on the border between Nepal and China.
words.example_cn: 珠穆朗玛峰位于尼泊尔和中国的边界上。

words.example_en: Two climbers were confirmed to have reached the top in 1953.
words.example_cn: 1953年有两名登山者被证实登上了峰顶。

words.example_en: The climbers knew the trip would include crowds, cold and danger.
words.example_cn: 登山者知道这趟旅程会有人群、寒冷和危险。

words.example_en: What we get from this adventure is just sheer joy.
words.example_cn: 我们从这次冒险中得到的纯粹是喜悦。

words.example_en: Most attempts to climb the peak end in either success or failure.
words.example_cn: 大多数登顶尝试的结果不是成功就是失败。

words.example_en: He was not afraid of failure when he set out on the adventure.
words.example_cn: 踏上这次冒险时,他并不害怕失败。

words.example_en: A psychologist spent years studying people who love taking risks.
words.example_cn: 一位心理学家花了数年研究喜欢冒险的人。

words.example_en: These risk-takers live for the thrill of a new adventure.
words.example_cn: 这些冒险者为新冒险的刺激而活。

words.example_en: It was spring when our ship sailed from port for the last time.
words.example_cn: 我们的船最后一次从港口起航时正值春天。

words.meaning_cn: 未觉察到的;未意识到的
words.example_en: We played cards, happily unaware that a deadly storm was near.
words.example_cn: 我们玩着牌,丝毫没意识到致命的风暴正在逼近。

words.example_en: Clean the cut with fresh water or alcohol before covering it.
words.example_cn: 在包扎前用清水或酒精清洗伤口。

words.example_en: Once the wound is dry, cover it with a clean bandage.
words.example_cn: 伤口干燥后,用干净的绷带包好。

words.example_en: Put a thermometer under the tongue to take the person's temperature.
words.example_cn: 把体温计放在舌下,为伤者量体温。

words.example_en: A first aid kit should include a pair of rubber gloves.
words.example_cn: 急救包里应该有一副橡胶手套。

words.example_en: Use cotton wool balls to clean the area around the wound.
words.example_cn: 用药棉球清洁伤口周围。

words.example_en: She pressed a piece of cotton wool gently onto the cut.
words.example_cn: 她把一块药棉轻轻按在伤口上。

words.example_en: Read the first aid guidelines carefully before any adventure.
words.example_cn: 在任何冒险之前,仔细阅读急救指南。

words.example_en: Put pressure on the cut with a clean cloth to stop the bleeding.
words.example_cn: 用一块干净的布按压伤口以止血。

words.example_en: Once the bleeding has stopped, clean the wound with fresh water.
words.example_cn: 止血之后,用清水清洗伤口。

words.example_en: Wash an insect bite with some liquid medicine first.
words.example_cn: 先用一些液体药物清洗被昆虫叮咬的地方。

words.example_en: Learning first aid helps you deal with an injury on a trip.
words.example_cn: 学习急救能帮你处理旅途中的受伤。

words.example_en: Highway 318 stretches over 5,000 kilometres across China.
words.example_cn: 318国道在中国境内绵延超过5000公里。

words.example_en: The biologist and his servant joined a ship to find the creature.
words.example_cn: 这位生物学家和他的仆人登上一艘船去寻找那个生物。

words.example_en: The strange creature turned out to be a secret submarine.
words.example_cn: 那个奇怪的生物原来是一艘秘密潜水艇。

words.example_en: They met Captain Nemo, the man in charge of the submarine.
words.example_cn: 他们见到了掌管潜水艇的尼摩船长。

words.example_en: The captain told the crew that the ship would sail at dawn.
words.example_cn: 船长告诉船员,船将在黎明起航。

words.example_en: Captain Nemo walked ahead, with one of his men behind.
words.example_cn: 尼摩船长走在前面,他的一名手下跟在后面。

words.example_en: Captain Nemo did not permit his guests to leave the submarine.
words.example_cn: 尼摩船长不允许他的客人离开潜水艇。

words.example_en: This adventure is adapted from a chapter of Verne's famous book.
words.example_cn: 这次冒险改编自凡尔纳名著中的一章。

words.example_en: Words were not enough to relate the wonders he had seen.
words.example_cn: 言语不足以讲述他所见的奇景。

words.example_en: Inside his thick helmet, his head shook like a nut in its shell.
words.example_cn: 在厚厚的头盔里,他的头像壳中的坚果一样晃动。

words.example_en: His head moved inside the helmet like a nut shaking in its shell.
words.example_cn: 他的头在头盔里晃动,像坚果在壳里摇动。

words.example_en: The power of the light under the ocean astonished the biologist.
words.example_cn: 海底光线的力量令这位生物学家大为惊讶。

words.example_en: The rays of the sun shone easily through the watery mass.
words.example_cn: 阳光轻易地穿透了那片水体。

words.example_en: The strong light seemed to consume all the colour around him.
words.example_cn: 强烈的光线似乎吞没了他周围所有的颜色。

words.example_en: He could clearly distinguish objects far away under the sea.
words.example_cn: 他能清楚地看清海底远处的物体。

words.example_en: Beyond that point, the colours gradually disappeared into deep blue.
words.example_cn: 在那之外,颜色逐渐消失于深蓝之中。

words.example_en: The water that surrounded him was almost as clear as air.
words.example_cn: 环绕着他的海水几乎和空气一样清澈。

words.example_en: The sand was even, not wrinkled like that on a flat shore.
words.example_cn: 那片沙地平整,不像平坦海岸上的沙子那样起皱。

words.example_en: The bright sand drove away the sunlight with wonderful intensity.
words.example_cn: 明亮的沙地以惊人的强度反射着阳光。

words.example_en: At a depth of thirty feet, he could still see as if in daylight.
words.example_cn: 在三十英尺深处,他仍能看得如同白昼。

words.example_en: Deep under the ocean, he could see as if in broad daylight.
words.example_cn: 在深海之下,他看得仿佛在大白天一样。

words.example_en: A whole new world lay beneath the surface of the sea.
words.example_cn: 海面之下藏着一个崭新的世界。

words.example_en: The grey seals are the lovely residents of the Farne Islands.
words.example_cn: 灰海豹是法恩群岛可爱的居民。
